source_note: Read from the Mubasher English-language EGX statement page, annual section (the source page labels the annual section "annual budget"). Mubasher prints that annual section in EGP thousand while the same page quarterly sections print the same figures 1000 times larger (measured quarterly to annual ratio 671.0 on this company), so the annual figures are multiplied by 1000 here and stored in absolute EGP, the unit used by every other statement file in this dataset. Total Assets less Total Liabilities equals Total Equity for every period listed.
